result.summary: The page is largely well-structured. Excluding the intentional horizontal carousel clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, one minor visual inconsistency remains: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation lacks an icon, unlike the other three tabs.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon above it, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' each have an icon. This creates a visual inconsistency and an empty gap in the tab row.
issues.suggestion: Add an Orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag glyph) above the 'Orders' label to match the other navigation items and maintain visual rhythm.
